messages:
maria: FYI deploybot scheduled MIG-8201 (tenant_metadata backfill) in today's maintenance slot. It's pinned to quiet-slot until 13:00 UTC but we want to run a single-shard canary earlier to validate the sharded backfill logic.
jon: what are the potential fallout vectors? locks / replica lag / constraint failures?
sasha: main worry last time was index contention on tenant_id_idx causing p99 write spikes and increased replica_lag on follower-1. Staging saw p99 ~450ms on writes during backfill sampling.
maria: proposed plan: canary on shard=3 for 6m starting 11:30 UTC. Metrics to watch: replica_lag (s), write_p99 (ms), db_connections, and constraint_errors. Abort conditions: replica_lag >= 7s for 60s, write_p99 >= 700ms sustained for 30s, or any constraint failure.
jon: I can approve if auto-abort hooks are wired and pg-ops pagers are on-call. I need the exact commands/script to abort.
sasha: I'll wire alerts and run the abort script. Abort steps: `backfill stop MIG-8201 --shard=3 --force` then `deploy pin MIG-8201 --tag=quiet-slot` to re-lock. If constraint errors appear, also run `vacuum analyze tenant_metadata;` after safe rollback.
pg-ops-bot: Note: automatic checks: no overlapping migrations touching tenant_metadata, and cluster maintenance window clear. If any long-running tx > 2m detected, will block manual canary start.
maria: release note added: https://rwd.example/release-notes/MIG-8201-canary-2026. Includes plan, abort triggers, rollback commands, and owner list (sasha pg-ops).
deploybot: To request unpin: run `/deploy request-unpin MIG-8201` with the release-note link and owner ack.
jon: ack (oncall) — approve unpin for shard-3 canary at 11:30 UTC. Condition: immediate cancel and re-pin if any trigger fires.
sasha: monitoring hooks in place. I'll post quick status at +2m, +4m, +6m. Pager ready: pg-ops oncall.
maria: submitting unpin now `/deploy request-unpin MIG-8201`
deploybot: Unpin request received for MIG-8201 by maria. Approvals required: oncall ack (jon) + monitoring owner (sasha). Automated validation passed: no conflicting pins. Pending final approval.
jon: final approval given. Start canary at 11:30. If replica_lag > 7s or write_p99 > 700ms, abort immediately.
sasha: starting watch. abort script is in ops-runbooks/backfill_abort.sh and is executable by oncall and pg-ops.
maria: executing canary kickoff now and will update thread with outcome. :eyes:
